Encode the applicable condition as PC6/PC7 AND (bowVerticalSideStatus true OR normalFrameAngle in [0,10] DEG), then require bowDesignForceMethod. Ensure the non-applicable branch cannot pass a PC6/PC7 ship merely because bowVerticalSideStatus is false when an in-range angle establishes applicability, and continue requiring sufficient branch-selection evidence so missing status/angle data cannot accidentally pass.

Repair the PC6/PC7 non-applicable branch: it currently requires at least one normalFrameAngle and requires every supplied angle to be outside 0–10 degrees, so a ship explicitly marked bowVerticalSideStatus=false can fail merely because angle evidence is absent or contains mixed in-range/out-of-range values. Encode this branch as bowVerticalSideStatus=false together with negation of the ship-level in-range angle condition, rather than applying NormalFrameAngleOutOfRangeShape to every angle value. Retain the applicable branch requiring bowDesignForceMethod when the status is true or the relevant angle condition is satisfied.

Replace the qualifiedMinCount existence test for normalFrameAngle with a property constraint that requires at least one angle and applies gen:NormalFrameAngle0To10DegreeValueShape to every normalFrameAngle value. The current shape incorrectly treats a ship as applicable when only one considered sub-region is within 0–10 degrees while other supplied sub-region angles are outside that envelope.
